initial.occasion: Cedar Hall volunteer lunch — replacement dish review
initial.notice: The herb chicken tray is unavailable. Please choose one of the kitchen’s replacement dishes.

options.title: Roasted squash pilaf with toasted seeds
options.detail: Golden squash, fragrant rice and toasted seeds, packed in a warm service tray with a separate herb dressing.

options.title: Slow-braised lentils with tomato and rosemary
options.detail: A rich lentil and tomato braise with rosemary, served with a separate tray of seasonal greens.

options.title: Lemon orzo with garden vegetables
options.detail: Lemon-dressed orzo with peas, courgette and garden herbs. This dish has no remaining production capacity.

kitchenNotes: Keep the hot trays sealed until the service team is ready. Open one tray at a time so that the remaining portions stay warm during the first seating.
The replacement arrives with a printed ingredient card. Place that card next to the serving utensils and keep it with the food throughout the lunch service.
Use a separate serving spoon for each dish. Please do not move spoons between trays when arranging the table or replenishing the buffet.
The portion count on this request is the number prepared by the kitchen, not a count of individual guests. Tell the service lead about any late arrivals before opening a spare tray.
Reusable trays should be emptied and stacked in the labeled return crate. The existing credit shown here applies only to the return already recorded on this order.
The kitchen labels each tray with the order reference and the final dish name. Check both labels before moving trays from the loading area to Cedar Hall.
If the organizer sends a revised replacement request, share its final serving count with the service team. The kitchen will use the latest request revision for its preparation list.
After the final seating, leave the ingredient card and the empty return crate at the service desk. The collection team will reconcile the tray count with the organizer.
